study: Scoring diagnostics, structural sensitivity, and expanded viral coverage
original_experiment: Frozen archive; no original candidate selection, scores, ground truth, or scientific source is changed
core_fit_rationale: Sensitivity to the variable receptor head; a diagnostic rigid fit, not a claim of the correct binding pose
preparation: Verified EvoEF2 BuildMutant default 10 rotamer passes then RepairStructure default 1 pass; fixed backbone; two protein chains only
fixed_e2_control: Recombine each mutant receptor with its WT model E2 coordinate records before computing binding
primary_directional_controls: Corrected original single-mutation soluble-E2 controls; 11 distinct mutation-direction labels. Do not retune the failed gate
external_source_challenge: Drummer 2005 PMID 15670777 abstract: F150S,T166I,C157S,C190R reduced; K124T,V146E retained but unquantified. Labels already consulted; exploratory, not blinded validation
sampling: NCBI default-order bounded convenience sample; not prevalence
expanded_positions: Union of original geometric positions, both experimental E2/tamarin-CD81 interfaces at 5 A mapped independently to H77, and the five already curated E2 binding positions
future_reserve: Seed 20261011; connected Hamming-distance <=1 haplotype components; components with any previously retrieved accession or near previously exposed interface haplotype are development only; reserve 20% of remaining novel components
state_model: Archival human scaffold, specified before new scores; expanded panel does not use the best diagnostic structure
claims: No affinity improvement, neutralization, broad viral protection, or experimental validation claim. Do not select a best-scoring structure using these control outcomes
